# Vendored aeon-ui-engine

Pinned copy of **aeon-ui-engine v1.3.9** from `GenericCPU/aeon-ui` (private repo).

Desktop CI installs via `file:vendor/aeon-ui-engine` so release builds do not need npm publish or GitHub cross-repo checkout.

When `aeon-ui-engine@1.3.9+` is on npm, switch `package.json` back to the registry and delete this folder.
